name: Yellow Stem Borer
damage_symptoms: Dead hearts (vegetative stage); White ears (reproductive stage); Central shoot dries up
threshold_per_plant: 1 moth/trap/night (pheromone trap); 5% dead heart; 1% white ear
management_chemical: Cartap hydrochloride 50 SP @ 1 g/L; Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 2 mL/L; Flubendiamide 20 WG @ 0.5 g/L
management_biological: Trichogramma japonicum @ 5 lakh/ha; Cotesia flavipes parasitoid release; NPV application
management_cultural: Clip seedling tips before transplanting; avoid excess nitrogen; remove egg masses; light trap @ 1/ha

name: Brown Planthopper (BPH)
damage_symptoms: Hopperburn - circular drying patches; yellowing and collapse of plants; honeydew secretion
management_chemical: Buprofezin 25 SC @ 1 mL/L; Imidacloprid 200 SL @ 0.5 mL/L; Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3 g/L
management_biological: Release of egg parasitoid Anagrus nilaparvatae; conserve spiders
management_cultural: Avoid over-application of nitrogen; keep bund clean; alternate wetting and drying; avoid resistant varieties breaking down

name: Leaf Folder
damage_symptoms: White longitudinal stripes on leaves; leaf margins rolled and tied; scraped leaf tissue
management_chemical: Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 2 mL/L; Monocrotophos 36 SL @ 1.5 mL/L; Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 mL/L
management_biological: Trichogramma chilonis @ 5 lakh/ha; Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2 kg/ha
management_cultural: Light traps; remove egg masses; avoid dense planting

name: Thrips
damage_symptoms: Rolling of leaf tips; silvery streaks on leaves; leaf tip drying; stunted growth
management_chemical: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 mL/L; Acephate 75 SP @ 1.5 g/L
management_cultural: Avoid drought stress; proper water management; avoid seedling stage stress

name: Gall Midge
damage_symptoms: Silvery shoot (onion shoot / silver shoot); tillers converted to tubular silver leaf; no panicle
management_chemical: Carbofuran 3 G @ 33 kg/ha (soil application); Fipronil 0.3 G @ 25 kg/ha
management_biological: No effective biocontrol; egg parasitoid Platygaster oryzae
management_cultural: Early planting before mid-June to escape peak; remove silver shoots; flood field for 3-4 days

name: Cotton Bollworm
damage_symptoms: Bore holes in bolls/fruits; feeding on developing seeds; frass outside entry hole
management_chemical: Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 mL/L; Emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L; Indoxacarb 15.8 EC @ 0.7 mL/L; Lambda-cyhalothrin 5 EC @ 1 mL/L
management_biological: HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha; Trichogramma chilonis @ 1 lakh/ha; Chrysoperla carnea releases
management_cultural: Pheromone traps @ 5/ha; light traps; intercropping with coriander; destroy residue

name: Whitefly
damage_symptoms: Yellowing; sooty mold on honeydew; virus vector (CLCV in cotton; TLCV in tomato; YVMV in okra)
management_chemical: Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 0.3 g/L; Spiromesifen 240 SC @ 0.75 mL/L; Buprofezin 25 SC @ 1 mL/L
management_biological: Encarsia formosa parasitoid; Verticillium lecanii @ 5 g/L
management_cultural: Yellow sticky traps; reflective mulch; remove infected plants; avoid continuous cotton/tomato

name: Mango Hopper
damage_symptoms: Flowers and tender shoots scorched; honeydew deposits; sooty mold; reduced fruit set
management_chemical: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.5 mL/L; Lambda-cyhalothrin 5 EC @ 1 mL/L; Quinalphos 25 EC @ 2 mL/L
management_cultural: Two sprays at panicle emergence and after fruit set; pruning for aeration; clean orchards

name: Banana Pseudostem Borer
damage_symptoms: Frass from holes in pseudostem; yellowing of leaves; plant topples; internal tunneling
management_chemical: Chlorpyrifos 20 EC injection in pseudostem @ 10 mL in 10 mL water/plant
management_cultural: Use tissue culture plants; remove decaying matter; pheromone traps; destroy stubble after harvest

name: Coconut Rhinoceros Beetle
damage_symptoms: Characteristic V-shaped cut on fronds; damaged unopened spindle; reduced growth
management_chemical: Apply Chlorpyrifos 20 EC in crown and leaf axils
management_biological: Oryctes virus application (Baculovirus) in breeding sites; Metarhizium anisopliae
management_cultural: Remove and burn breeding sites (dead wood, compost heaps); keep crown clean; hook out adults

name: Tomato Fruit Borer
damage_symptoms: Circular entry holes in green fruits; droppings visible at entry; fruit rots internally
management_chemical: Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 mL/L; Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 mL/L
management_cultural: Pheromone trap (Helilure) @ 5/ha; field sanitation; early harvesting; remove volunteer plants

name: Chilli Thrips
damage_symptoms: Upward curling of leaves; distortion of growing points; silvery appearance; stunted growth
management_chemical: Acephate 75 SP @ 1.5 g/L; Fipronil 5 SC @ 1 mL/L; Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 mL/L
management_biological: Blue sticky traps; Amblyseius cucumeris predatory mite
management_cultural: Blue sticky traps @ 12/ha; avoid drought stress; spray water jets; avoid overlapping crops

name: Sugarcane Internode Borer
damage_symptoms: Dead heart (early stage); blind eye; bored internodes; red rotting inside stalk
threshold_per_plant: 5% dead heart; 10% dead heart merits spray
management_chemical: Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 2 mL/L; Monocrotophos 36 SL @ 1.5 mL/L
management_biological: Cotesia flavipes @ 5000 pairs/ha; Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoid
management_cultural: Remove dead heart material; avoid ratoon without proper gap; balanced fertilization

name: Groundnut Leaf Miner
damage_symptoms: Leaf folding and binding; blotch mines; defoliation; reduced photosynthesis
management_chemical: Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.7 mL/L; Quinalphos 25 EC @ 2 mL/L
management_cultural: Avoid late sowing; field sanitation; deep summer ploughing to expose pupae

name: Okra Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus Vector (Whitefly)
tamil_name: வெண்டை மஞ்சள் நரம்பு வைரஸ் தாவல் பூச்சி
damage_symptoms: Yellowing of veins; interveinal chlorosis; mosaic; reduced fruit size; viral disease vector
threshold_per_plant: 1 whitefly/leaf (low threshold due to virus transmission)
management_chemical: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 mL/L; Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3 g/L
management_cultural: Use YVMV-tolerant varieties (Co5); rogue infected plants early; yellow sticky traps; mineral oil spray
